Four open questions, one recommendation each.

Q1 is the one that changes code: 3 of the 6 over-allocation findings on the demo org are false positives, and the number goes to 233 findings at 1,000 people.

Q4 is a live bug — the lens already writes workspace-wide from the topbar.

Nothing here is built. These are proposals to react to, not decisions taken.

The two things I'd want your call on before any of it becomes code: the Spread threshold (3 teams?) and whether 'declared %' earns its place on a finding at all.
